title: Weight of the Blade (Okabe-style battle)
style: Epic melancholic orchestral battle music in the style of Keiichi Okabe's NieR soundtracks: haunting ethereal female lead vocal singing wordless invented-language syllables, layered choir chants, driving staccato string ostinato, piano arpeggios, taiko and orchestral war drums, soaring strings, French horns and brass swells, subtle electronic pulses, bittersweet minor-key melody, building from a fragile intro to a soaring, tragic, powerful climax, D minor, 4/4, 140 BPM
lyrics:
[Intro - orchestral, piano and low strings, no vocals]

[Verse - ethereal female vocal, strings build]
Ka lei sa nei, vo ri a mo
Sei la tu me, kai ro na do
Ela sa mi, tora ve ni
Kai la sen do, mira ve li

[Chorus - full orchestra, choir chants, soaring vocal]
Sha na ra vei, o ka lei sa
Mira to ne, vei la sa mo
Sha na ra vei, ko ra si la
Tei la mo ne, ai ra sa lo

[Verse - driving strings and war drums]
Nei sa lo ri, ke ra mo dei
Va lu na te, si ro me la
Ora sei mi, tala ve no
Kai ra sen ta, lira me do

[Chorus - full orchestra, choir chants, soaring vocal]
Sha na ra vei, o ka lei sa
Mira to ne, vei la sa mo
Sha na ra vei, ko ra si la
Tei la mo ne, ai ra sa lo

[Bridge - piano and solo vocal, drums pull back, then choir rebuilds]
Ah, ah, sha na ra
O ka lei, mira to ne
Ah, ah, vei la sa
Kai ra sen ta, ai ra sa lo

[Chorus - climax, massive orchestra, full choir, taiko, soaring vocal]
Sha na ra vei, o ka lei sa
Mira to ne, vei la sa mo
Sha na ra vei, ko ra si la
Tei la mo ne, ai ra sa lo

[Outro - strings and piano fade, last vocal phrase]
Sha na ra vei, ah
Mira to ne, ah
